text.en: For truly your names are glorified on earth,
text.ar: لأنه حقاً هكذا يتمجد إسمكم على الأرض،

text.cop: ⲧⲏⲛ ⲅⲏⲛ ⲕⲉ ⲫ̀ⲑⲟⲛⲓⲕⲟⲛ ⲧⲟⲛ Ⲑⲉⲟⲛ ⲧⲟⲛ ⲁ̀ⲡⲟⲥⲧⲟⲗⲟⲛ.
text.cop_lat: teen geen ke efthonikon ton Theon ton apostolon.
text.en: O all you Apostles, the chosen ones of God.
text.ar: يا جميع مختاري الإله، أبائنا الرسل.

text.en: (Simon Peter on Rome,

text.cop: ⲕⲉ Ⲁⲛⲇ̀ⲣⲉⲁ̀ⲥ Ⲓⲥ ⲕⲉⲑⲓⲛ Ⲓⲁⲕⲱⲃⲟⲥ ⲧⲟⲩ Ⲍⲉⲃⲉⲇⲉⲟ̀ⲥ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉϥ ⲉⲣⲈ̀ⲫⲣⲓⲕⲓⲁ.
text.cop_lat: ke Anedre-as Is kethin Yakobos tou Zebede-os entef erefrikia.
text.en: Andrew and Thomas and James the Son of Zebedee on Africa.
text.ar: وإندراوس وتوما ويعقوب بن زبدى على أفريقيا.

text.cop: Ⲟⲩⲥⲁⲩⲧⲟⲥ Ⲓⲱⲁ̀ⲛⲛⲟⲩ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ Ⲁⲥⲓⲁ ⲙ̀ⲡⲟⲗⲓⲥ ⲟⲡⲧⲉⲛⲧⲁ ⲛ̀Ϥ̀ⲣⲁⲅⲓⲁ:
text.cop_lat: Ousavtos Yo-annou ente Asia empolis optenta enefragia:
text.en: Truly John on the city of Asia and was also counted on Africa,
text.ar: وحقاً يوحنا على آسيا المدينة وحُسب على أفريقيا،

text.en: Philip and Bartholomew on India.

text.cop: Ⲥⲓⲙⲱⲛ ⲟⲩⲔⲁⲛⲁⲛⲓⲧⲏⲥ ⲕⲉ Ⲑⲟⲙⲁⲥ ⲟ̀ⲕ̀ⲗⲏⲣⲟⲥ ⲣⲁϣⲉⲛ ⲙ̀Ⲙⲁⲧⲑⲉⲟ̀ⲥ ⲙ̀ⲡⲉⲣⲧⲟⲥ ⲕⲉ ⲕⲉⲥⲧⲟⲥ ⲕⲉ ⲕⲁⲥⲧⲓⲕⲏⲥ:
text.cop_lat: Simon oukananitees ke Thomas o-ekleeros rashen emmatthe-os empertos ke kestos ke kastikees:
text.en: Simon the Canaanite and Thomas his relative with Matthew on (Agam) and Yemen,
text.ar: سمعان القانوي وتوماس نصيبه مع متَّى العجم واليمن،

text.en: and Matthias according to his lot.

text.cop: Ⲓⲁⲕⲱⲃⲟⲥ ⲧⲟⲩ Ⲁⲗⲫⲉⲟ̀ⲥ ⲕⲉ Ⲑⲁⲇⲇⲉⲟ̀ⲥ ⲟ̀ⲕ̀ⲗⲏⲣⲟⲥ:
text.cop_lat: Yakobos tou Alfe-os ke Thadde-os o-ekleeros:
text.en: James the Son of Alphaeus and Thaddaeus their relative,

text.cop: ⲣⲁϣⲉⲛ ⲙ̀Ⲙⲁⲧⲑⲓⲁⲥ ⲥⲟⲥⲱⲛ ⲧ̀ⲣⲱⲡⲓ ⲕⲉ ⲁ̀ⲡⲁⲥ ⲕ̀ⲧⲟⲩⲇ̀ⲣⲓⲁ̀ⲥⲟⲩ.)
text.cop_lat: rashen emmatthias soson etropi ke apas ektou-ethri-asou.)
text.en: with Matthew their partner in the feared places, their third in the tribulations.)
text.ar: مع متىَّ شريكهم في المواضع الرهبة، وثالثهم في الشدائد.)

text.en: Their voices went forth,
onto the face of the whole earth,
and their words have reached,
the ends of the world.
Intercede on our behalf,
O Lady of us all the Theotokos,
text.ar: يا سيدتنا كلنا السيدة والدة الإله،

text.en: Mary the Mother of Jesus Christ,
that He may forgive us our sins.

text.cop: Ⲧⲱⲃϩ ⲙ̀Ⲡ̀ⲟ̅ⲥ̅ ⲉ̀ϩ̀ⲣⲏⲓ ⲉ̀ϫⲱⲛ ⲱ̀ ⲛⲁⲟ̅ⲥ̅ ⲛ̀ⲓⲟϯ ⲛ̀ⲁ̀ⲡⲟⲥⲧⲟⲗⲟⲥ ⲛⲉⲙ ⲡ̀ⲥⲉⲡⲓ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲛⲓⲙⲁⲑⲏⲧⲏⲥ:
text.cop_lat: Tovh emepshois e-ehree egon o nashois enioti enapostolos nem epsepi ente nimatheetees:
text.en: Pray to the Lord on our behalf, my masters the fathers the Apostles, and the rest of the Disciples,
text.ar: أُطلبوا من الرب عنا، يا سادتي الآباء الرسل، وبقية التلاميذ،

text.en: that He may forgive us our sins.
For Any of the Archangels:
Intercede on our behalf,
O holy archangel,
that He may forgive us our sins.
For Saint John the Baptist:
Intercede on our behalf,
O forerunner and baptizer,
John the Baptist,
that He may forgive us our sins.
For Any Apostle:
Pray to the Lord on our behalf,
O disciple of Christ,
(...) the Apostle,
that He may forgive us our sins.
For Saint Mark the Apostle:
Pray to the Lord on our behalf,
O beholder of God the Evangelist,
Abba Mark the Apostle,
that He may forgive us our sins.
For Any Martyr:
Pray to the Lord on our behalf,
O struggle-mantled martyr,
that He may forgive us our sins.
For Any Saint:
Pray to the Lord on our behalf,
O our righteous holy father,
Abba (...),
that He may forgive us our sins.
If the Patriarch is Present:
Pray to the Lord on our behalf,
O our holy father the patriarch,
Pope Abba Shenouda the high priest,
that he may forgive us our sins.
And If a Bishop is present:
Pray to the Lord on our behalf,
O our holy and righteous father,
Abba (...) the Bishop (Metropolitan),
that He may forgive us our sins.
Hail to my masters and fathers,

text.en: the Apostles,
hail to the disciples,
of our Lord Jesus Christ.

text.cop: Ⲛⲓⲣⲱⲙⲓ ⲉⲧⲧⲁⲗⲏⲟⲩⲧ ⲉ̀ⲛⲓⲉ̀ϫⲏⲟⲩ ⲛⲏⲉⲧⲉⲣϩⲱⲧ ϩⲓ ⲑⲁⲗⲁⲥⲥⲁ:
text.cop_lat: Niromi ettaleeout eni-ejeeou nee-eterhot hi thalassa:
text.en: All you men aboard the ships upon the sea,
text.ar: أيها الرجال الراكبون السفن المقلعون في البحيرة،

text.cop_lat: amoini o-ah theenou ensoi entaer theenou enowohi enreftahe romi.
text.en: come follow me so that I make you fishers of men.

text.cop: Ϫⲉ ⲛⲏⲉ̀ⲧⲉⲧⲉⲛⲛⲁⲥⲟⲛϩⲟⲩ ϩⲓϫⲉⲛ ⲡⲓⲕⲁϩⲓ ⲉⲩⲉ̀ϣⲱⲡⲓ ⲉⲩⲥⲟⲛϩ ϧⲉⲛ ⲛⲓⲫⲏⲟⲩⲓ̀:
text.cop_lat: Je nee-etetennasonhou hijen pikahi eveshopi evsonh khen nifeeoui:
text.en: For whatever you retain on earth will be retained in the heavens,
text.ar: فإن ما تربطونه على الأرض يكون مربوطاَ في السموات،

text.cop: ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲛⲏⲉ̀ⲧⲉⲧⲉⲛⲛⲁⲃⲟⲗⲟⲩ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ϩⲓϫⲉⲛ ⲡⲓⲕⲁϩⲓ ⲉⲩⲉ̀ϣⲱⲡⲓ ⲉⲩⲃⲏⲗ ϧⲉⲛ ⲛⲓⲫⲏⲟⲩⲓ̀.
text.cop_lat: o-woh nee-etetennavolou evol hijen pikahi eveshopi evveel khen nifeeoui.
text.en: and what you loosen on earth will be loosen in the heavens.
text.ar: وما تحلونه على الأرض محلولاً في السموات.

text.en: Our Lord Jesus Christ,

text.en: has chosen His Apostles,
who are Peter and Andrew,
and John and James.
Philip and Matthew,
Bartholomew and Thomas,
James the son of Alphaeus,
and Simon the Canaanite.

text.cop: Ⲛ̀ⲑⲱⲧⲉⲛ ⲇⲉ ϧⲁ ⲛⲏⲉ̀ⲧⲁⲩⲟ̀ϩⲓ (ⲛⲉⲙⲏⲓ) (ⲅ̅) ϧⲉⲛ ⲛⲁⲡⲓⲣⲁⲥⲙⲟⲥ:

text.cop: ϯⲛⲁⲥⲉⲙⲛⲓ ⲛⲉⲙⲱⲧⲉⲛ ⲛ̀ⲧⲁⲇⲓⲁⲑⲏⲕⲏ ⲉ̅ⲑ̅ⲩ̅ ϣⲁ ⲉ̀ⲛⲉϩ.
text.cop_lat: tinasemni nemoten entathiatheekee ethowab sha eneh.
text.en: I render to you My holy covenant forever.
text.ar: أنا اُقرر لكم عهدي المقدس إلى الأبد.

text.en: I will make you eat with Me on My table in My Kingdom,
text.ar: وأجعلكم تأكلون معي على مائدتي في ملكوتي،

text.cop: ϯⲛⲁⲧ̀ϩⲉⲙⲥⲉ ⲑⲏⲛⲟⲩ ⲉ̀ϫⲉⲛ ⲙⲏⲧⲥ̀ⲛⲁⲩ ⲛ̀ⲑ̀ⲣⲟⲛⲟⲥ ⲉ̀ⲣⲉⲧⲉⲛⲉ̀ϯϩⲁⲡ ⲉ̀ϯⲙⲏⲧⲥ̀ⲛⲁⲩ ⲙ̀ⲫⲩⲗⲏ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ Ⲡⲓⲥⲣⲁⲏⲗ.
text.cop_lat: tina-ethemse theenou ejen meetesnav enethronos eretenetihap etimeetesnav emfilee ente Pisraeel.
text.en: sit you on twelve thrones judging the twelve tribes of Israel. (Luke 22:30)
text.ar: وأجلِسكم على إثنى عشر كرسياً وتدينون الإثنى عشر سبط في إسرائيل.

text.en: Paralex:
Come listen to the precious
and expensive pearl,
the caller of righteousness,
Luke the Evangelist.
He speaks with the glory and the honor,
of my masters the fathers the Apostles,
and their exalted manner,
and rank that was granted to them.
+ Let us praise the Lord, for with glory, He was glorified.

section.en: Let Us Praise the Lord (A-somain, Ⲁ̀ⲥⲱⲙⲉⲛ, Ⲙⲁⲣⲉⲛϩⲱⲥ

text.en: He ascended into the heavens, and sent us the Paraclete, the Spirit of Truth.
Amen alleluia.
(G-E) Asomen to Kerio, en-zoxos ghar the-zoxasi,
a-nellthon yes oo-ranos, axi-ton parak-liton, to epnev-ma tis ali-theias.
Ameen Alleluia.
(C-E) Maren hos e-Ep-shoic, je khen oo-o-oo ghar afchee o-oo,
afshe-naf e-ebshoy e-nifiowi, afo-o-orp nan empi Parakleeton, Pi-ebnevma ente-ti-meth-mee.
Ameen Alleluia.
(A-E) Falno-sabbeh el-Rab, lean-naho bel magdi tamaggad, sa-'eda ee-la a'ala al-samawat,
wa arsal lana al-Parak-leete, roh al-huq-el-mo-azzi.
Ameen Alleluia.
+ He made the two become one, that is, the heaven and the earth. He ascended into the heavens ....
(G-E) Tous ze-o ektisas yes eena, ton oo-ranon ke teen geen, a-nell-thon yes oo-ranos, axi-ton parak-liton, to epnev-ma tis ali-theias.
Ameen Alleluia.
(C-E) Pen-taf-er pee esnav en-oway, ete fai peh etfe nem-ep-kahi, afshe-naf e-ebshoy e-nifiowi, afo-o-orp nan empi Parakleeton, Pi-ebnevma ente-ti-meth-mee.

text.cop: ⲉ̀ⲧⲉ ⲫⲁⲓ ⲡⲉ ⲧ̀ⲫⲉ ⲛⲉⲙ ⲡ̀ⲕⲁϩⲓ.
text.cop_lat: ete fai pe etfe nem epkahi.
text.en: Ameen Alleluia.
(A-E) Ga-`ala-al-ethnai-ni wahi-dan, ay-el-sama wal-ard, sa-'eda ee-la a'ala al-samawat, wa arsal lana al-Parak-leete, roh al-huq-el-mo-azzi. Ameen Alleluia.
+ Come all you nations, to worship Jesus Christ. He ascended into the heavens ....
(G-E) Zevte pantis ee-la-ee, epros keni-somen Eso Ekh-restoo, a-nellthon yes oo-ranos, axi-ton parak-liton, to epnev-ma tis ali-theias.
Ameen Alleluia.
(C-E) Amoinee ni-la-os teero, enten-oo-osht en Isos Pikh-restos,
afshe-naf e-ebshoy e-nifiowi, afo-o-orp nan empi Parakleeton, Pi-ebnevma ente-ti-meth-mee. Ameen Alleluia.
(A-E) Ta-'alo ya gamee-'a-al she-`oob, le nas-good le Yaso´a al-Massieh, sa-'eda ee-la a'ala al-samawat, wa arsal lana al-Parak-leete, roh al-huq-el-mo-azzi. Ameen Alleluia.

text.cop: + Ⲟⲩⲧⲟⲥ ⲉⲥⲧⲓⲛ ⲟ̀ Ⲑⲉⲟⲥ ⲟ̀ Ⲥⲱⲧⲏⲣ ⲏ̀ⲙⲱⲛ:
text.cop_lat: + Outos estin o Theos o Soteer eemon:
text.en: + This is God our Savior, and the Lord of all flesh. He ascended into the heavens ....
(G-E) Oontos yestin O The-os O So-teer eemon, ke Kee-reyos pasis sarkos, a-nellthon yes oo-ranos, axi-ton parak-liton, to epnev-ma tis ali-theias.
Ameen Alleluia.
(C-E) Fai pe Efnoo-ti Pen-soteer, owoh Ep-shois en sarex-se niven, afshe-naf e-ebshoy e-nifiowi,
afo-o-orp nan empi Parakleeton, Pi-ebnevma ente-ti-meth-mee. Ameen Alleluia.
(A-E) Haza howa Allah mokhales-na, wa Rabbo kolle gasad , sa-'eda ee-la a'ala al-samawat, wa arsal lana al-Parak-leete, roh al-huq-el-mo-azzi. Ameen Alleluia.
+ Three in one and one in three, the Father, the Son, and the Holy Spirit, the Spirit of Truth.
Amen alleluia. (G-E) Etria-seen moo-nazi, ke mona-seen Etr-ia-zee,
O Pa-teer ke O Ey-yos, keto agion Epnevma, to Epnevma tis alithias.
Amen Alleluia.
(A-E) Thalooth fi wahed, wa wahed fi thalooth, al-Ab wal-Ebn wal-Roh el Kodos, roh-el-hakk-el mo-'azzi .
Amen Alleluia.
+ A perfect Trinity, triangled and unified, that is the Father the Son, and the Holy Spirit, the Spirit of Truth.
Amen Alleluia. (C-E) Oo-etrias es-jeek evol, es-oi-en-shomt esoi-en-owai,

text.cop: ⲉ̀ⲧⲉ ⲫⲁⲓ ⲡⲉ Ⲫ̀ⲓⲱⲧ ⲛⲉⲙ Ⲡ̀ϣⲏⲣⲓ:
text.cop_lat: ete fai pe Efiot nem Epsheeri:
text.en: ete fai pe Efiot nem Ep-sheeri, nem pe-Epnevma eth-owab, Pi-ebnevma ente ti-methmee.
Ameen Alleluia.
(A-E) Tha-looth kamel mo-tha-lath wa mo-wa-had, al-lazi lel-Ab wa al-Ebn wa-al-roh el-Qo-dos, roh-el-hakk-el mo-'azzi.
Amen Alleluia.
Our fathers the Apostles,

text.cop: ⲛ̀ⲑⲟϥ ⲉ̀ⲧⲉⲣϭⲁⲩⲙⲱⲓⲧ ϧⲁϫⲱⲟⲩ ϣⲁ ⲛ̀ⲧⲟⲩⲧⲁⲥⲑⲟ ⲛ̀ϯⲟⲓⲕⲟⲩⲙⲉⲛⲏ ⲉ̀ϧⲟⲩⲛ ⲉ̀ⲡ̀ⲥⲟⲩⲉⲛ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ϯⲙⲉⲑⲙⲏⲓ.
text.cop_lat: enthof eterchavmoit khagoou sha entoutasto entioikoumenee ekhoun e-epsowen ente timethmee.
text.en: He guided them to return the world to the knowledge of the truth.
text.ar: هو الذي أرشدهم حتى ردُّوا المسكونة إلى معرفة الحق.

text.en: Alleluia Alleluia Alleluia,
bless the air of the heaven.
May Your mercy and Your peace be a
fortress to Your people.
Holy holy holy,
Lord of hosts,

text.cop: ⲡ̀ⲗⲏⲣⲏⲥ ⲟ̀ ⲟⲩⲣⲁⲛⲟⲥ ⲕⲉ ⲏ̀ ⲅⲏ:
text.cop_lat: epleerees o ouranos ke ee gee:
text.en: heaven and earth,
are full of Your holy glory.
